tips.text: Run Exta solo; squadmates make Kril retarget, swing wide and stack status effects that can lock him up.
Pop the coolant tubes with Arca Plasmor, Valkyr slams or Excalibur's Exalted Blade so any angle works.
Skip Cold and Heat damage on Kril; Cold lengthens his invulnerable windows and Heat thaws him early.
Break a tube, hit him a few times, then let the phase play out; huge burst the instant he is vulnerable can bug him invulnerable for good.
Abort and rerun if a Proboscis Cernos tendril explosion stops the pipes from ever opening again.
Expect a classic early-game RNG farm; going 25 runs without one specific part is a running joke.
Expect to stand around waiting on Kril's freeze animation; nobody calls the fight hard once they know the trick.
